about: Attributes a [hex_nests] test can name. source is the parent array the field reads on the card; reduce is how a (levels, cells) source becomes one value per cell. A new attribute is a row here whose source a route already forms. dx_defaults are starting thresholds per parent spacing, to be calibrated against MRMS by looking at the pictures.

fields.name: refl
fields.about: composite reflectivity: the column maximum of the 10 cm reflectivity the microphysics forms on a look step

fields.name: storm_object
fields.about: the same composite reflectivity, meant for object_km2 tests (connected cells on the mesh)

fields.name: wmax
fields.about: column maximum vertical velocity: the dycore's own end-of-step w (every physics route, hexcore.nest_look_dycore)

fields.name: mucape
fields.about: most-unstable CAPE at the look: MPAS-A v8.4.2's convective diagnostics kernel (getcape, most-unstable parcel) on the dycore's columns, every physics route (hexcore.nest_look_dycore)

fields.name: uh25
fields.about: 2-5 km updraft helicity at the look (MPAS's formula on the dycore's vorticity and w), every physics route (hexcore.nest_look_dycore)
